grid.expression: SELECT V.CODPROD AS PRODUTO, SUM(V.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, V.PARCEIRO FROM (SELECT PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR AS CODPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, CAB.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.NOMEPARC AS PARCEIRO FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND SUBSTR(PRO.CODPROD,1,1) = '3' INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.DTPREVENT <= :P_DTCORTE GROUP BY PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR, CAB.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.NOMEPARC ORDER BY PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR) V GROUP BY V.CODPROD, V.PARCEIRO ORDER BY V.CODPROD
